Panthers outscored 9-1 the last 24 hours.  Tonight, to a decimated Penguins lineup.

The assist was really nice by Koivunen, but it wasnt even his best pass of the night. He had that slick alley-oop backhand pass that was going to spring a Penguin for a breakaway if 71 didnt get called for a trip behind the play

He is learning the pace of the NHL and he already has the hands/mind

The way the staff has deployed the forwards this year hasn't made a lot of sense.

You move Novak to wing now with Kindel out?

Is there even a plan to try and get the most out of Chinakhov?

Why is Robertson damned to the 4th line all the time?

So these are the lines from today's practice.  Kindel should be back relatively soon, but Rust is out for at least 6 weeks

Novak-Crosby-Rakell
Koivunen-Lapierre-Malkin
Kuzmenko-Lizotte-Chinakhov
Soderblom-Dewar-Robertson

Penguins currently have 7 standings points... yeesh
One of the early season miracles is that Erik Karlsson is on a 92 point pace without a defense partner and a consistently useless power play (I don't think he is the problem on it)

Things are so bad that a Penguins coach finally decided to play Sidney Crosby and Evgeni Malkin together at even-strength (hallelujah) 

In 6:42 together they were 74.50 xGF%

This tough stretch has been tough for the Penguins.  0-4 in their last four.  Have lost seven out of their last eight games.

The GM isn't going to wait around much longer

Final- Golden Knights 6, Penguins 2

Vegas continues to take care of bad hockey teams with relative ease. They've been a machine through 10 games.
The Penguins have actually looked ok with the puck, but defensively they've been a complete mess, and the Golden Knights have eaten them alive.
Five unanswered goals for the Avalanche and they beat the Penguins 5-2.

Perhaps the coaching staff's biggest failure so far this season is not getting close to the tangible results they should be getting out of Kindel based on how good he looks.

Put him with Malkin , Novak hasn't done anything as a top 6 center this year
Rakell doesnt deserve to be anywhere near the power play right now

I dont understand the people who don't think Koivunen should be in the lineup. 

Last year he 100% didn't deserve it.

This year he has been good. 

Most of the nights he has been in this year there's been a complete dud on the opposite wing. Not tonight
